description: A forested trail above Creston, B.C. that is part of the Mt. Thompson trail network.
directions: From downtown Creston, take Highway 3 to the East to the Canyon-Lister road junction on the right. Turn right and follow the road for 1km to Whimster Road on the left. Take Whimster Road for 0.7km to the start of Mt. Thompson FSR. Proceed onto this FSR, and where the road forks into 3, take the central road (gravel plant on right). Stay right at the first junction at 1km. The trail head is located at the 3.4km mark in a large pull out area.
title: Rotary
